# System configuration fixtures

Real `/etc/resolv.conf` and `/etc/hosts` files, used to test how dog finds
the system nameserver and warns about names in the hosts file.

| File | Origin |
|---|---|
| `resolv.conf.docker` | Written by Docker Engine inside `debian:stable-slim` (Debian 13) |
| `resolv.conf.debian` | A Debian 12 workstation with a static configuration and a commented-out IPv6 nameserver |
| `resolv.conf.networkmanager` | NetworkManager’s format, with an IPv6 nameserver listed first |
| `resolv.conf.systemd-resolved` | The stub file generated by systemd-resolved (systemd 252) |
| `hosts.docker` | Written by Docker Engine inside `debian:stable-slim` |
| `hosts.debian` | The default layout from a Debian 12 install |

Private addresses and domain names in the originals were replaced with
documentation values (`192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, `corp.example`,
`example.org`). The structure of each file, its comments, spacing and
ordering, was kept exactly as it was.
